AttachmentLocation.description: One screenshot pinned to a real Binance window. Confirmed once, kept for good.

mode.description: Explicit create or open; a failed create never silently opens another repository.

match_end_at.description: Display-only boundary. Bars after this instant never enter similarity ranking.

interval.description: Required selected screenshot interval; cross-interval search is not supported.

ChartSetup.description:
Which overlays the replay stage draws. The backend stores the shape only and
never computes an indicator.

columns.description: Canonical field -> exact CSV header. No inferred columns or inferred assets.

keychain_service.description: A Keychain item reference only; plaintext credentials are never accepted by this API.

symbol_start_at.description: Explicit per-contract continuation; each value is bounded by start_at/end_at.

interval.description: Required selected screenshot interval; cross-interval search is not supported.

max_vectors.description: A hard admission limit over a cycle. Increase explicitly after sizing.

quantity.description: Signed in BOTH mode, nonnegative for LONG/SHORT. Null means unknown opening position.

leverage.description: Explicit manual supplement: historical leverage is not inferred from today's settings.

comparison_policy.description: exact_frozen_rule: absolute levels remain distinct. No inferred equivalence.

grouping.description: episode_rule or call_rule; fixed before reading outcomes.

info.description: Modular Rust backend. UTC timestamps, decimal strings, immutable evidence, bounded history, resumable review drafts. See docs/status.md for acceptance limits.
info.title: Scorebook Backend
